parse.title: Cosmic Cyclone
parse.wikitext:
'''Cosmic Cyclone''' (スペースサイクロン ''Supēsu Saikuron'', '''Space Cyclone''') is an [[:Category:Alien Enemies|Alien]]/[[:Category:Floating Enemies|Floating]] [[:Category:Cyclones|Cyclone]] that appears in [[Event Stages]] and [[Zero Legends]]. It was added in [[Version 4.0 Update|Version 4.0]]. {{Enemy Info |name = Cosmic Cyclone |image = E 179.png |first appearance = [[Black Hole Rising (Insane)|Dimension of Despair]]
'''ZL''': [[Mirage Meadow|Sub-chapter 7 - Mirage Meadow]] |money drop = 999¢ - 3,946¢ }} ==Enemy== It has above-average range for a [[:Category:Cyclones|Cyclone]], with two dangerous abilities: it is able to [[Weaken|weaken]] cats' attack power to 10% (assuming they survive its attack), and it doubles its attack power at 450,000 HP (30%). It is highly recommended to use [[:Category:Anti-Alien Cats|anti-Alien cats]] and [[:Category:Anti-Floating Cats|anti-Floating cats]] to take this Cyclone down, but make sure to check their ranges in comparison to Cosmic Cyclone before using them. Before attempting to fight this enemy, it is also recommended to have all [[Anti-unstarred Alien Treasures]] from at least the first and second chapters of [[Into the Future]] to reduce its attack power and health, making it more manageable. ==Strategy== [[Bishop Cat (Rare Cat)|Sanzo Cat]] and pre-[[True Form]] [[Shaman Cat (Rare Cat)|Shaman Cat]] only have 10 more range than Cosmic Cyclone, so counting on them may be a liability, but [[Ururun Wolf (Special Cat)|Ururun Cat]], [[Psychocat (Rare Cat)|Neo Psychocat]] and [[Surfer Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Castaway Cat]] create a very strong team against it. [[Lizard Cat (Normal Cat)|King Dragon Cat]] and [[Crazed Lizard Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Crazed Dragons]] as well as [[Gross Cat (Normal Cat)|Macho Leg Cats]] can be stacked up to dish out huge amounts of damage. [[Li'l Gross Cat (Special Cat)|Li'l Macho Legs Cat]] can be useful for knocking it back, but other effects are generally preferred. Units from the [[Justice Strikes Back! Dark Heroes (Gacha Event)|Dark Heroes]] and [[Nature's Guardians ELEMENTAL PIXIES (Gacha Event)|ELEMENTAL PIXIES]] events can help a lot against this enemy, such as [[Mizli (Uber Rare Cat)|Mizli]], [[Voli (Uber Rare Cat)|Voli]], [[Akira (Uber Rare Cat)|Akira]], [[Warlock and Pierre (Uber Rare Cat)|Warlock and Pierre]], [[The White Rabbit (Uber Rare Cat)|The White Rabbit]], etc. ==Description== {{Description |Mode = Enemy |Number = 179 |Type = Alien/Floating |Image1 = Enemy icon 179.png |Name1 = Cosmic Cyclone |Desc1 = A nebula storm born from a black hole,
